title: Check If It Is a Straight Line
summary: Given an integer array of coordinates, verify if the points form a straight line in the XY plane.
statement: Given an integer array of coordinates, verify if the points form a straight line in the XY plane.
constraints: Avoid floating-point slopes and support vertical lines.
hints: Two points define a direction vector (dx,dy).
A later displacement (x-x0,y-y0) is parallel exactly when its cross product with the direction is zero.
Integer cross multiplication handles vertical lines and avoids slope rounding.
editorial: Integer cross multiplication handles vertical lines and avoids slope rounding.

tests.explanation: Every displacement is a multiple of direction (1,1).
The final point has a different slope from the first two.
